_comment: OPTION 2 TEST. Identical to run16_G5S20R4_federated_full except that the gated ground-differenced ROTATION solve is switched on. Two-way ISL fixes the formation SHAPE but is exactly blind to the formation's rigid ROTATION (measured range Jacobian along a rotation direction = 1e-16, machine zero), so the orientation of rel.solvedPos is whatever the per-asset EKF priors supplied -- set by the GROUND link at sigma_theta ~ sigma_abs/(R*sqrt(N)). This scenario adds an Earth-referenced observable: tower->satellite code DOUBLE differences (between satellites, then between towers), which removes the tower clock, the tower survey error, the per-satellite differential clock and the per-satellite constant code bias without estimating any of them. differentialAtmosphereSigma_m = 0 is the PHYSICALLY CORRECT case: two satellites 2 km apart at GEO look through the same air column (11 arcsec ray divergence), so the deterministic atmosphere differences away to 0.006-1.6 mm. Compare against run20, which injects the independent-per-satellite atmosphere the simulator actually generates.
